t.suuqiyeIsAMarketplaceBuilt: SUUQIYE is a marketplace built around how people already do business. Browse listings by category, search for exactly what you need, and message sellers directly to ask questions, negotiate, and arrange a meetup. List an item in minutes with photos, a price, and a description, then track offers and messages from interested buyers. Follow sellers you trust, save your favorite listings, and leave reviews to help others shop with confidence.

t.accountInformationFromGoogleSign: Account information from Google Sign-In or Sign in with Apple (your name, your email address — which may be an Apple private relay address if you choose to hide your email — and, with Google, your profile photo), used to create your SUUQIYE profile. Profile details you choose to add, such as phone number, city/region, gender, birthday, bio, and — for business accounts — business name, description, address, website, hours, logo, banner, and delivery availability. Listing content you post, including titles, descriptions, categories, prices, condition, city/region, and photos. Content generated by using the app, such as favorites, follows, reviews you give or receive, offers, saved searches, saved addresses, recently viewed listings, chat messages, and reports you file. A device notification token used only to deliver push notifications to your device.
t.photosYouUploadListingPhotos: Photos you upload — listing photos, your profile picture, and business logo/banner — are stored with Cloudflare R2, our image hosting provider. Our database stores only the resulting image addresses, never your raw photo files.
t.theSuuqiyeWebsiteDoesNot: The SUUQIYE website does not access your device location. The SUUQIYE mobile app only uses your device location if you tap "Find listings near me" on the home screen. The phone then asks for permission, and the app takes a single approximate reading while it is open to suggest your country and city — never in the background. The reading is matched to our list of cities on your device; the coordinates are not sent to our servers, not stored, and not shared. Only the place you confirm is saved, on your device, as your browsing filter. On Android, the operating system may use Google Play services to determine the position, under Google's own terms. You can decline and choose your country and city manually, or turn location off at any time in your device settings. City and region on your profile, listings, and pickups are values you choose yourself from a list.
t.toOperateTheMarketplaceShow: To operate the marketplace — show your listings, connect you with buyers and sellers through chat and offers, and send relevant notifications — to keep the platform safe by reviewing reports and blocking abusive accounts, and to improve the app based on aggregate usage patterns. We do not use your data for advertising, and we do not sell it to third parties.
t.weUsePushNotificationsDelivered: We use push notifications, delivered through Firebase Cloud Messaging (a Google service) and, on iOS, the Apple Push Notification service, to alert you to new messages, offers, favorites, follows, reviews, price drops, and account activity. You can turn categories of notifications on or off anytime in Settings > Notification Preferences, and revoke notification permission from your device settings.
t.weShareDataOnlyWith: We share data only with the service providers that run SUUQIYE, solely to provide the app's functionality: Supabase (our database, authentication, and in-app chat), Google (Sign-In and Firebase Cloud Messaging for push delivery), Apple (Sign in with Apple and, on iOS, the Apple Push Notification service), and Cloudflare R2 (image hosting). We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use advertising or analytics services that track you across other apps.
t.accessToYourDataIn: Access to your data in our database is restricted with row-level security policies, so only you can read or change your private information, and only what's meant to be public — like listings and profile info — is visible to others. Photo uploads use short-lived, single-use signed links rather than exposing storage credentials to the app. Data sent to and from SUUQIYE is encrypted in transit.
t.youCanEditOrDelete: You can edit or delete most of your data from Settings at any time, including your profile, listings, favorites, and saved addresses. From Settings > Delete Account, you can permanently delete your account. This is irreversible and immediately removes your profile and business details, listings and photos, favorites, followers/following, reviews, saved searches and addresses, notifications and device tokens, and chat conversations from our systems. Reports you filed are also deleted; reports other users filed about your account may be retained for platform safety, consistent with standard moderation practice.
t.suuqiyeIsNotDirectedAt: SUUQIYE is not directed at children. As stated in our Terms of Use, you must be at least 18 years old, or have a parent or guardian's permission, to create an account.
t.weMayUpdateThisPolicy: We may update this policy as SUUQIYE evolves. Material changes will be reflected here with an updated date.
t.questionsAboutThisPolicyOr: Questions about this policy or your data can be sent to suuqiyesupport@gmail.com.

t.suuqiyeIsAMarketplaceThat: SUUQIYE is a marketplace that connects buyers and sellers. You must be at least 18 years old, or have a parent or guardian's permission, to create an account. Accounts are created using Google Sign-In or Sign in with Apple. You are responsible for everything posted or sent from your account.
t.sellersMustAccuratelyDescribeItems: Sellers must accurately describe items, own the right to sell them, and use real photos of the actual item for sale. SUUQIYE is not a party to any transaction between buyers and sellers — we do not handle payments, shipping, or escrow, and we are not responsible for the quality, safety, or legality of items listed.
t.youMayNotListStolen: You may not list stolen, counterfeit, illegal, or dangerous goods, or use SUUQIYE to harass, scam, mislead, or impersonate another person or business — see our Community Guidelines for details. Use the Report button on any listing, profile, or review to flag a violation. We may remove any listing, review, or account that violates these terms, our Community Guidelines, or local law, at our discretion.
t.weStronglyRecommendMeetingIn: We strongly recommend meeting in a public place, inspecting an item before paying, and never sending money in advance to someone you have not met. SUUQIYE cannot reverse a payment made outside the app and is not liable for losses from in-person transactions.
t.youKeepOwnershipOfThe: You keep ownership of the photos, text, and messages you post, but you grant SUUQIYE a license to host and display that content within the app so listings can be browsed, chats can be delivered, and reviews can be shown to other users. You are responsible for having the rights to anything you upload.
t.weMaySuspendOrTerminate: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, receive repeated credible reports, or engage in fraudulent activity. You can permanently delete your account at any time from Settings > Delete Account; see our Privacy Policy for what is removed.
t.suuqiyeReliesOnThirdParty: SUUQIYE relies on third-party services to operate, including Google (Sign-In and push notifications), Apple (Sign in with Apple and push notifications on iOS) and cloud hosting and storage providers. Your use of those underlying services may also be subject to their own terms.
t.theSuuqiyeNameLogoAnd: The SUUQIYE name, logo, and app design are owned by SUUQIYE and may not be copied or used without permission. You keep ownership of your own content as described above.
t.suuqiyeIsProvidedAsIs: SUUQIYE is provided "as is." We do not guarantee the accuracy of listings, the conduct of users, or that the app will always be available or error-free. To the extent permitted by law, SUUQIYE is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the app.
t.weMayUpdateTheseTerms: We may update these terms as SUUQIYE evolves. Continued use of the app after a change means you accept the updated terms.
t.questionsAboutTheseTermsCan: Questions about these terms can be sent to suuqiyesupport@gmail.com.
